## Premise falsified by measurement — CI DOES see this: every push-to-main `Lint & Repo Gates` run since the control landed is red at step 31

The card says *"CI never sees this: a PR branch always has a diff, so the case is green there."* That holds for `pull_request` and `merge_group` runs (a queue branch has a diff), but **the `push` run on `main` has none** — `HEAD` equals `origin/main`, `--changed` refuses with exit 2, the control fails.

Measured from `GET /actions/workflows/lint.yml/runs?event=push&branch=main` (cancelled = superseded by the next push under concurrency; every run that completed is listed):

| main push | Lint & Repo Gates | note |
|---|---|---|
| `101ad2cc1` … `4428dd575` (09-03 19:41Z → 22:39Z) | success ×4 | before the control |
| **`369da918d`** (09-03 23:23Z, #15105 — the commit that added the control) | **failure** | first red |
| `35e94c96b`, `97a22639b`, `f594e70d7`, `2cc461030`, `fcc42e6c1`, `1876d5dfd`, `ebb082204`, `5c584231a`, `c351a84da`, `919beca43`, `50d6c924b`, `9c1bcda38`, `1bc3c092a`, `460134af8`, `4dd5041bd`, `0e24b0c2c`, `fbecffe1d`, `5b09356b7`, `3a4373f4c` (09-03 23:52Z → 09-04 09:57Z) | failure ×19 | every completed push run |

Failing step confirmed on three of them by job read (`3a4373f4c` job `100985021378`, `5b09356b7`, `fbecffe1d`): **step 31 `PM dispatch-gates self-test`**, `Process completed with exit code 1`. The `merge_group` run of the same `3a4373f4c` head (job `100979536132`) is green — which is why the queue keeps merging while `main`'s own status has been red for ~11 hours.

Reproduced by this seat on a checkout equal to `origin/main` (`ed217e697`, then `3a4373f4c`): `1 of 1381 case(s) failed`, the only ✗ being this control; the direct invocation prints the `changes nothing against 'origin/main' … nothing to derive` refusal and exits 2.

**Consequences beyond the fresh-worktree baseline:** `main`'s commit status is red on every push, so anything that reads the base branch's health (the "red on the base branch too" triage rule, `check-required-contexts`' assumptions, the release line's green-main precondition) is reading a false signal, and a real main red would now be invisible in the noise.

**Grading:** `domain:devx` + `tooling` + `pm:queue`, dispatched now as S — the file is `scripts/pm/**` (not governed); the only open PR touching `dispatch-gates.mjs` (#15301) adds one unrelated ledger row.

**Shape ruled for the dispatch (the card's first option):** the control asserts that the flag combination PARSES and REACHES the derivation, so it accepts **either** `status === 0` with stdout, **or** `status === 2` with the `changes nothing against` refusal on stderr — and gains a positive control that an *illegal* combination is refused with a different status and message, so the case stays load-bearing. No `--self-test` case is weakened to pass; the case is corrected to test its own claim.

## ACCEPT → PR #15320 (head `209f5c596`)

Reviewed on the branch (`origin/main...claude/issue-15278-changed-commands-control`), not the self-report:

- **One file, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, +55/−3.** The control now asserts its own claim: `reachedDerivation(run)` = exit 0 with a command list **or** exit 2 whose stderr carries `NO_DIFF_REFUSAL` — a new module constant (`:19615`) that the derivation's print site interpolates (`:19817`), so the case and the message cannot drift apart. The **positive control** runs `--changed --commands <path>` through the SAME predicate and requires it to FAIL (exit 2, the argv sentence `--changed derives the paths itself`, and NOT the no-diff sentence) — a parse refusal can never satisfy the corrected control. No other case touched; the usage-line assertions are untouched; no `COMPOUND_ANCHOR_LEDGER` row is owed (no selfTest-shaped name, no new path literal). No TDZ: the const sits before the `if (invokedDirectly)` dispatch (`:19650`).
- **The red reproduced by this seat before the fix** (comment `5539149925`): a checkout equal to `origin/main` → `1 of 1381 case(s) failed`, the only ✗ being this control; the direct invocation prints the refusal and exits 2.
- **Green after, path (a), run by this seat** on a detached review worktree at `209f5c596` (a tree with a diff): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, **1382 cases pass**, both new lines ✓ (`…parses and REACHES the derivation…`, `…REJECTS the illegal --changed-with-a-path combination…`).
- **Path (b), the push-to-main shape, exercised by the dev** in a clone whose own `origin/main` ref was pointed at the commit (HEAD == origin/main): direct probe exit 2 with the refusal, full self-test `1382 cases pass` under the verify lock — the exact tree shape that was red is green. The ablation (the illegal combination made legal on disk, blob hash moved) reds exactly the positive control and nothing else; restore proven by hash equality + empty diff.
- **CI on `209f5c596`:** 22 success / 11 skipped, `Lint & Repo Gates` in progress with **step 31 `PM dispatch-gates self-test` already `success`**; `skip-changeset` + `size/s`; `Fixes #15278` in the PR body only.

**The proof that matters lands after the merge:** the next `push` run of `lint.yml` on `main` must be green at step 31 — this seat reads it from `/actions/workflows/lint.yml/runs?event=push&branch=main` and records it here before stripping labels. #15312 (same file, serial-queued) is dispatched once this merges.

Flipping ready + arming auto-merge over MCP now.

## PROOF — `main`'s push run is green at step 31 again

Push run `33871119985` (`lint.yml`, `event=push`, `branch=main`, head `2ed6be649`, the third push after #15320's merge — the two before it were cancelled by concurrency before reaching the step): **step 31 `PM dispatch-gates self-test` → `success`** (`/actions/runs/33871119985/jobs`, Lint & Repo Gates job, step completed 12:1xZ).

Control: the last completed push run before the fix, `33867807567` (`6e67b86c0`, 11:24Z), reads step 31 `failure` — the same shape every completed push run had from `369da918d` (09-03 23:23Z) onward.

So the sequence on `main` is: 4 green (before #15105) → 20 red (the control) → **green at the first completed push after #15320**. Card stays closed; `pm:dispatched` and the assignee were stripped at merge time. The seat post (#6023) records the run id.
